title: Biased Fourier coefficients of a coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p\in(0,1)$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates. The biased Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function that returns the sign in coordinate $i$ is the bias mean $1-2p$ if $S$ is empty, the bias standard deviation $\sqrt{4p(1-p)}$ if $S=\{i\}$, and zero otherwise.
